summary: The article provides a largely accurate overview of the RBI's new guidelines on fair practices, though it misstates the effective date of the new rules and the name of the relevant RBI directions.

claims.claim: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has issued new guidelines to curb unfair sales practices by banks and financial service providers.
claims.note: RBI has indeed tightened rules on the sale of financial products to curb mis-selling and unfair sales practices.

claims.claim: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced comprehensive "Directions on Fair Practices Code for Lenders" to address these issues head-on.
claims.note: While the RBI has a 'Fair Practices Code for Lenders' (which has existed since 2003 and was updated in 2015), the new comprehensive framework addressing dark patterns and mis-selling is referred to as a new framework or new rules, not specifically as new 'Directions on Fair Practices Code for Lenders'.

claims.claim: The new norms will take effect from January 1, 2027.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm that the new norms will come into effect from January 1, 2027.

claims.claim: If you suspect mis-selling or unfair practices, first raise a complaint with your bank. If unresolved, escalate it to the RBI's Integrated Ombudsman Scheme.
claims.note: The RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS) 2021, and the updated 2026 scheme, both require customers to first lodge a complaint with the Regulated Entity concerned. If the complaint is not resolved within 30 days or the customer is dissatisfied, they can then approach the RBI Ombudsman.

claims.claim: The RBI's framework ensures that customers have a clear path to seek recourse if they believe they have been subjected to unfair practices.
claims.note: The RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS) provides a cost-free and expeditious grievance redress mechanism for customers of RBI-regulated entities.

claims.claim: If mis-selling of a financial product/service is established, the bank shall refund the entire amount paid by the customer for purchase of the financial product/service and also compensate the customer for any loss arising due to mis-selling.
claims.note: The RBI has introduced a compensation framework stating that if mis-selling is established, the bank shall refund the entire amount paid and compensate for any loss.

claims.claim: These "Directions on Fair Practices Code for Lenders" apply to all Regulated Entities (REs) under the RBI's purview, which includes commercial banks, cooperative banks, NBFCs, and other financial service providers.
claims.note: The RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS) 2021 and 2026 applies to Regulated Entities (REs) which include banks, NBFCs, Payment System Participants, and Credit Information Companies.

article_title: RBI Cracks Down on Bank's "Dark Patterns" and Mis-selling
